title: The Memory Price
logline: When paramedic Nia Calder attempts an impossible revival, an immortal archivist warns that saving the patient will erase his only memory of the entity connecting them.
synopsis: Paramedic Nia Calder hears a dying commuter's final memory and discovers immortal archivist Rowan Vale within a century-old scene. Rowan warns that reviving the patient will erase his only memory of a faceless entity, so Nia records his testimony before choosing the rescue. The patient survives wearing an antique tag Rowan recognizes, but Rowan's memory vanishes and his journal creates a blank page bearing Nia's name.
hook: A dying patient's final memory shows Nia an immortal stranger staring back at her from a century ago.
target_audience: English-speaking viewers who enjoy supernatural mystery, restrained romance, and identity conflict.
episode_goal: Establish the memory exchange and force Nia to choose a patient's life over certainty about the entity.

characters.name: Nia Calder
characters.description: A disciplined paramedic who secretly hears the final memories of dying patients.
characters.motivation: Save every life she can without letting her supernatural burden endanger others.

characters.name: Rowan Vale
characters.description: An immortal archivist whose memories vanish whenever Nia pulls someone back from death.
characters.motivation: Preserve enough evidence of the memory-trading entity to stop it before his identity disappears.

characters.name: Eli Mercer
characters.description: A critically injured commuter wearing an antique silver emergency tag.
characters.motivation: Survive long enough to deliver an impossible warning.

scenes.purpose: Introduce Nia's ability, Rowan, and the silver emergency tag.
scenes.setting: A stalled subway car lit by flickering emergency lamps.
scenes.beat_summary: While treating Eli in a stalled subway car, Nia hears his final memory and sees Rowan inside an incident from 1924.
scenes.emotional_shift: Professional focus turns into impossible fear.
scenes.emotional_objective: Make Nia's familiar secret suddenly tangible and dangerous.
character_actions: Nia presses gauze to Eli's chest as the subway lights pulse.
Eli grips a tarnished silver emergency tag around his neck.
Rowan steps from the dark tunnel holding an old leather journal.
scenes.turning_point: Rowan appears in person exactly as he looked in Eli's century-old memory.

scene_causality.goal: Stabilize Eli and understand the impossible vision.
scene_causality.conflict: Eli is dying while Nia experiences a century-old memory containing Rowan.
scene_causality.outcome: Nia recognizes Rowan from Eli's final memory as Eli loses his pulse.

dialogues.intent: Pass on the warning haunting his final memory.
dialogues.text: The man with no face said the tag would bring me back.

dialogues.intent: Confirm that Nia has entered a memory he recognizes.
dialogues.text: You saw me in 1924—and no living person should remember that night.

scenes.purpose: Define the supernatural rule and show Nia choosing rescue over preserved evidence.
scenes.setting: Beside Eli's stretcher in the stalled subway car.
scenes.beat_summary: Rowan explains the exchange as Nia records his fading description before attempting the revival.
scenes.emotional_shift: Impossible fear hardens into morally certain action.
scenes.emotional_objective: Frame cooperation as a costly moral choice rather than immediate trust.
character_actions: Nia aims her phone camera at Rowan and starts recording.
Rowan sketches a faceless silhouette on the final written page of his journal.
Nia sets down the phone and charges the defibrillator.
scenes.turning_point: Nia visibly charges the defibrillator after hearing the price of success.

scene_causality.goal: Preserve Rowan's evidence without abandoning Eli.
scene_causality.conflict: Saving Eli will erase Rowan's sole memory of the entity's face.
scene_causality.outcome: Nia records Rowan's description and commits to the revival despite the cost.
scene_causality.causal_link: Because Eli's heart stops and Rowan recognizes Nia's power, he reveals the cost of reviving him.

dialogues.intent: Stop the rescue long enough to preserve his crucial evidence.
dialogues.text: If you bring him back, I lose the only memory I have of the thing taking mine.

dialogues.intent: Reject a choice that treats Eli's life as expendable.
dialogues.text: Then tell the camera everything, because I am not letting him die for your certainty.

scenes.slug: INT. STALLED SUBWAY CAR - MOMENTS LATER
scenes.purpose: Pay off Nia's decision, reveal the tag's historical link, and launch the next mystery.
scenes.setting: The subway car as power returns and distant sirens approach.
scenes.beat_summary: Nia revives Eli, Rowan loses the entity's face, and his journal opens to a new blank page marked with Nia's name.
scenes.emotional_objective: Make the rescue triumphant, intimate, and immediately ominous.
character_actions: Nia shocks Eli, and he gasps back to life.
Rowan touches his temple as the face in his sketch bleaches into blank paper.
Eli's silver tag swings beside Rowan's journal as it turns itself to a page headed NIA CALDER.
scenes.turning_point: The self-turning journal reveals Nia's name where a memory should be.

scene_causality.goal: Restore Eli's heartbeat and determine what Rowan loses.
scene_causality.conflict: Eli's survival destroys Rowan's firsthand evidence and exposes Nia to the entity.
scene_causality.outcome: Eli survives, Rowan retains only Nia's recording, and the journal marks Nia on a blank page.
scene_causality.causal_link: Because Nia chooses to revive Eli, Rowan's memory of the entity is taken in exchange.

dialogues.intent: Verify the cost while anchoring Rowan in the present.
dialogues.text: The face—can you still see it?

dialogues.intent: Reveal that the exchange has now targeted Nia.
dialogues.text: No, but my journal remembers who it plans to erase next.

next_episode_question: Why has Rowan's supernatural journal created a blank page bearing Nia's name?
